notes: Council chamber redesign, plus 198 portraits and six changed faces. THE CHAMBER WAS ONE 2500px COLUMN: ring, four seat cards, composer, treasury, chat, accord list, log. You could never see who held a chair and what was being said in the room at the same time, which is most of what the page is for. It is now three regions. A BAND across the top holds the ring and the chairs and does not scroll. Under it, FLOOR on the left with the composer, the accords and the log, and ROOM on the right with the treasury and the chat, each scrolling on its own. FULLSCREEN uses the same mechanism cities uses, a class toggled on the pane, so there is one code path for it rather than two. Unlike cities it covers the tab bar, so the band carries its own way out. TEXT SIZE: all 82 inline sizes in council.js now scale off one variable driven by the SAME A+ / A- control the chat uses, at a 1.15 baseline. A second size control would be a second thing to discover and a second thing to get out of sync. UNDER 860px it collapses to a single column and the band drops the ring, because a 900x260 graphic at phone width is a smear and the cards carry the same information as text. SEAT CARDS are condensed to name, status and timer; the title and house note open on click, since four cards of static lore was most of the reading weight on a page you visit to see what changed. THE COMPOSER NEVER GOT ITS CARET BACK. 1.3.8.2 gave the room chat box caret and focus preservation across a rebuild and left the composer directly above it with the text only, the same mistake one element over in the other direction. Both column scroll positions are preserved too. Found by test, not by reading. ALSO IN THIS RELEASE: 198 new portraits taking the picker from 60 to 258, per group artist credit with gatlingart on the two new sets, six changed faces, and portrait framing rebuilt so faces are no longer cropped by a single hardcoded zoom. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED. Hard refresh.
